recipes.name: Baked salmon on leeks with crushed new potatoes and dill-mustard yoghurt

steps.name: Preheat and prep
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and boil the kettle. While they heat, halve the potatoes, wash and slice the leeks and trim the beans.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 2. At the same time lay the leeks and beans in the tray, sit the salmon on top with oil and lemon slices and bake for 12 minutes. Chop the dill and mix it into the yoghurt with the mustard.

steps.name: Crush the potatoes
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and peas and crush them lightly.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Set half aside for tomorrow and plate. Pierre-Guy: 540g and 50g yoghurt. Mariska: 360g and 35g yoghurt.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat gently, covered, in a pan for 4 to 5 min until piping hot, or eat the fish cold.

recipes.name: Butter bean, edamame and mushroom stroganoff

steps.name: Prep
steps.text: Dice the onion, mince the garlic and slice the mushrooms.

steps.name: Fry
steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil for 6 minutes.

steps.name: Spice
steps.text: Add the garlic and paprika and stir for 1 minute.

steps.name: Simmer
steps.text: Add the drained beans, edamame and stock and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.name: Spinach and rice
steps.text: Stir in the spinach until it wilts. Microwave one rice pouch at the same time.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Take off the heat and stir in the Dijon, yoghurt and Parmesan.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Set half aside and plate. Pierre-Guy: 420g and 150g rice. Mariska: 280g and 100g rice.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Microwave the second rice pouch fresh.

recipes.name: Spanish-style garlic prawns with peppers, courgette and almonds

steps.name: Prep
steps.text: Slice the peppers, dice the courgettes and slice the garlic.

steps.name: Toast the almonds
steps.text: Toast the almonds in the dry pan, then lift them out.

steps.name: Fry the veg
steps.text: Fry the peppers and courgettes in the oil for 6 minutes.

steps.name: Spice
steps.text: Add the garlic and paprika and stir for 1 minute.

steps.name: Prawns
steps.text: Add the prawns and peas and cook for 4 minutes until the prawns are pink right through. Microwave one rice pouch at the same time.

steps.name: Finish and plate
steps.text: Chop the parsley, squeeze over the lemon, scatter with almonds and plate. Pierre-Guy: 400g and 150g rice. Mariska: 270g and 100g rice.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat gently, covered, in a pan for 4 to 5 min until piping hot, or eat the fish cold. Microwave the second rice pouch fresh.
